# Draft:Foundation Software

= Foundation Software =
Foundation Software is a US-based developer and provider of construction software and services. Specializing in the commercial sector, the company is headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, and has been owned by private equity firm Thoma Bravo since 2020.
History
Founding and Early Years
Foundation Software was founded in 1985 by Fred Ode, who served as the company's first programmer. He began developing his construction accounting software, eventually named FOUNDATION®, to address the unique accounting and financial management needs of the construction industry, which traditional accounting software often failed to meet.
Throughout the late 1980s and 1990s, Foundation Software grew steadily as the construction industry increasingly adopted computer-based accounting systems.
The company initially focused on serving small to mid-sized contractors, helping establish a customer base in the Midwest before expanding nationally to serve contractors of all sizes, from specialty trade firms to large commercial operations.
Product Evolution
In its first two decades, Foundation Software primarily offered desktop-based solutions. The company's software, FOUNDATION, was built on Microsoft SQL Server, providing robust database capabilities for construction accounting.
Digital Transformation
As technology evolved and contractors increasingly needed access to data from dispersed jobsites and remote locations, Foundation Software began its transformation from desktop to cloud-based solutions.
This shift enabled real-time data synchronization, mobile access and improved collaboration between field and office teams.
Payroll Service Launch
In 2006, Foundation Software, wanting to address the challenges of construction payroll — including certified payroll requirements, prevailing wage compliance, union reporting and multi-state tax filing — created Payroll4Construction, a construction payroll service built off of the FOUNDATION system.
Growth and Facility Expansion
In 2013, the company relocated its headquarters within the Cleveland area to Strongsville, Ohio, tripling its office space to accommodate its expanding team and operations. This move cemented the company's commitment to the Northeast Ohio region.
Additionally, the company experienced significant employee and customer growth, particularly accelerating in the 2010s and 2020s, growing to approximately 285 employees by 2025.
Ownership and Acquisitions
In August 2020, private equity firm Thoma Bravo acquired Foundation Software. The acquisition was financed by funds managed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management's Private Credit Group, BlackRock US Private Credit and Interbank.
Foundation then looked to increase their portfolio offerings through strategic development and M&A. The company completed several acquisitions, including
* McCormick Systems (May 2021): Developer of McCormick, the takeoff & estimating software for electrical, plumbing and mechanical trades.
* Estimating Edge (January 2022): Creator of The EDGE® — takeoff and estimating for the roofing, concrete, fireproofing, interior & exterior finishing trades.
* AboutTime Technologies (May 2023): Eventually rebranded to “WorkMax,” the company developed the WorkMax mobile app — a time tracking and mobile resource management solution.
* Vendrix, Inc.  (June 2025): A construction financial management platform, which was renamed FOUNDATION Pay®, that offers corporate cards and bill pay features.
These acquisitions allowed Foundation Software to provide end-to-end solutions for construction businesses, from pre-construction estimating through project completion and financial closeout.
Products
Foundation Software offers construction software and services designed for contractors.
FOUNDATION
The company's flagship product is FOUNDATION, a construction-specific accounting, payroll and project management system.
Payroll4Construction
Payroll4Construction is a construction payroll service that manages the complexities of a contractor’s payroll like prevailing wage compliance, union reporting and multi-state tax filing.
The EDGE®
The EDGE is takeoff & estimating software for the roofing, fireproofing, concrete, interior and exterior finishing trades.
HQSuite
HQSuite is a platform of construction apps, consisting of:
* ProjectHQ: Project management
* hrHQ: Human resources management
* SafetyHQ: Safety management
* CrewHQ: Scheduling
* ExecutiveHQ: Executive job costing
WorkMax
WorkMax is a mobile time tracking and workforce management platform.
McCormick
McCormick is takeoff and estimating software designed for electrical, plumbing and mechanical (MEP) trade contractors.
FOUNDATION Pay®
FOUNDATION Pay is an expense & pay management platform for commercial construction companies.
Market
The company reports serving over 43,000 construction professionals in the United States. Its customer base includes contractors with annual revenues ranging from $1 million to $250 million. According to the company, approximately 80% of its users are trade contractors, with the remainder consisting of general contractors and heavy construction firms.
Industry affiliations
Foundation Software maintains active partnerships with construction industry organizations to contribute, educational resources and support for financial and operational best practices in the construction sector. These partnerships include:
* Associated Builders and Contractors (ABC)
* Construction Industry CPAs/Consultants Association (CICPAC)
* Construction Financial Management Association (CFMA)
* Associated General Contractors of America (AGC)
* American Subcontractors Association (ASA)
* Independent Electrical Contractors (IEC)
